nodes.title: Output-clock scheduler for replay (fe-813.3, fixes fe-lwp.15)
nodes.body:
## Summary
fe-813.3, which also resolves fe-lwp.15. File replay now sends MIDI from a dedicated output-clock scheduler thread; the UI frame only displays (ADR 0001, constraint 2).

- **`shell/schedule.{h,c}`:** an allocation-free ordered cursor with inclusive lookahead and stable order for equal times. Late events are kept in order, note-offs included. Seek drops the offs of notes that began before the target. Unit tested on Linux.
- **`shell/platform/scheduler.h`:** one worker with immutable events and nonblocking transport commands over an SPSC ring. Typed sink callbacks are the extension point for the looper's click and bar-boundary events. Teardown is ordered.
- **Windows backend:** QPC, `THREAD_PRIORITY_HIGHEST`, `timeBeginPeriod(1)`, a high-resolution waitable timer and a final spin of at most 1 ms, with absolute deadlines.
- **Tools:** `--timing-log`, `verify timing` and `zig build sched-probe`, which compares four wait strategies.

| Path (send-return lateness) | Events | Median | p99 | Max | Drift |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Frame-clocked, 37.3 ms fixture | 537 | 8979 µs | 17260 µs | 17822 µs | 13107 µs |
| Scheduled, 305 s replay | 8178 | 118 µs | 208 µs | 370 µs | −63 µs |

Alternatives measured: sleep, waitable timer, timer plus spin, and midiStream. Details are in `docs/sessions/fe-sched.md`.

## Test plan
- [x] `zig build test`, `asan`, `win` and `ui` are green. `verify all` has no FAIL.
- [x] The 5-minute replay was machine-checked by `tools/scheduler_check_log.py`: no early, failed or missing sends.

nodes.title: Time model: meter beat groups, subdivisions, loop cycles; group accents (fe-813.2)
nodes.body:
## Summary
fe-813.2: the musical time the looper runs on.

- **`core/time.{h,c}`:**
  - Meters are sequences of beat groups (4, 3+2/4, 2+2+3/8) over power-of-two denominators 1..64. Every subdivision from 2 to 8 per beat is an exact number of ticks.
  - Each track's length is counted in subdivisions. The loop cycle is the LCM of the track lengths, capped at 16 bars with a clear refusal message, and the module computes where tracks realign.
  - **Decision (user, 2026-10-17):** x/128 is for SMF analysis only. Non-power-of-two denominators are refused.
- **Field estimator:** onsets are weighted from group starts. 4/4 keeps 4,2,3,2. `form field --meter GROUPS[/D]` sets the meter.
- **New fixtures:** `additive_five` (5/4) and `additive_seven` (7/8) both read better with group accents. Golden is 566/650, and the original 648 rows are unchanged at 564.

## Test plan
- [x] `zig build test`, including `tests/test_time.c`, written failing first. `asan` and `win` are green.
- [x] `verify golden`, `field-all` and `meter` pass. `verify all` has no FAIL.
